_doc: The RULE STENCILS — canonical UHV-breakout archetypes simplified into named rules Zee validates. Each rule has a plain description, an ACTION (TAKE/SKIP), and a feature SIGNATURE (the stencil ranges the pattern-matcher checks against live/forming candles). Diagrams rendered by build_rule_diagrams.py. Matched live by pattern_matcher.py.

features_doc.side_leg: size (pts) of the trend hump BEFORE the retracement, in the trade direction
features_doc.dominance: trend leg vs opposite leg (>1.6 = one-sided trend, ~1 = ranging)
features_doc.origin_valid: did a counter-trend candle body-break the prior candle's extreme (retracement started)
features_doc.uhv_dominant: is the UHV clearly the highest-volume counter-trend candle in the pullback
features_doc.uhv_is_peak: is the UHV a local volume peak
features_doc.brk_body: breakout candle body/range (>=0.55 = momentum, <0.4 = mostly wick)
features_doc.brk_wick: rejection wick of breakout against the move (<0.35 good, >=0.4 indecision)
features_doc.brk_vol_ratio: breakout volume / UHV volume (<1 good, >=1 bad)
features_doc.brk_first: is this the FIRST candle to body-cross the UHV extreme

rules.name: Uptrend Momentum Breakout
rules.plain: Price is in a clear uptrend (a strong hump up before the pullback). It pulls back in red candles; the biggest-volume red candle is the UHV. The FIRST green candle then closes with a strong body above the UHV's high, on lower volume than the UHV. Buy the breakout.

rules.name: Downtrend Momentum Breakout
rules.plain: Mirror of Rule 1. Clear downtrend (strong hump down before the pullback). Green-candle pullback; biggest-volume green candle is the UHV. The FIRST red candle closes with a strong body below the UHV's low, on lower volume. Sell the breakout.

rules.name: Ranging / Choppy — SKIP
rules.plain: No clear direction — an up-leg AND a down-leg of similar size (dominance near 1). The formula does not work here. Do not trade.

rules.name: Wick Breakout — SKIP
rules.plain: Trend and UHV may be fine, but the breakout candle is mostly a WICK (indecision), not a strong body close through the UHV. Not a clean break. Skip.

rules.name: Marginal UHV — SKIP/RISKY
rules.plain: The 'UHV' is barely the highest-volume candle (not clearly dominant) or not a clean local volume peak. Weak signal. Skip or treat as risky.

rules.name: Wrong-Side / No Retracement — SKIP
rules.plain: Trading against the trend (buying in a downtrend / selling in an uptrend), OR the origin candle never body-broke the previous candle so no valid retracement started. Skip.
